name: Job listing rows

anchorId.note: the hero CTA is a plain native #jobs jump — no smooth-scroll JS is attached

href.note: The three real rows link to the company's Greenhouse board. This is one of the few intentional outbound links on the site; rel="noopener noreferrer" and target=_blank are required.

rows.note: 3 rows on the live original. No department grouping, no ATS iframe and no empty state — a flat Webflow collection list.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: full-width col-lg-12 rows; pill radius 128px, padding-inline 4em; hover flips to the dark primary fill over 300ms.
responsive.le991: rows keep full width; padding tightens.

notes: CASCADE: the row is a.faq-item.cc-listing.w-inline-block. The display fix must win on SPECIFICITY, not source order. The earlier measured defect rendered the pills inline-block at 160px instead of 120px with the arrow on the wrong side. See docs/CASCADE.md.
